name: Hybrid (TF-IDF text / LightGBM flow)
note: Text model when the HTTP request is readable (60%), flow model otherwise. Gain over flow-only: +0.022 [0.006; 0.046].

name: LightGBM (flow features)
note: Reference model, inbound traffic only (proxy duplicates removed).

name: TF-IDF char n-grams + logistic regression
note: Same score on texts never seen in training (0.993). URL alone: 0.956 on the hardest subset.

name: Char-CNN (PyTorch)
note: Ties TF-IDF on every test at about 15x the compute cost.

name: LightGBM (flow features, same rows)
note: Flow sizes cannot see the request content.

name: Random Forest
note: Statistical tie with LightGBM; lower recall at threshold 0.5.

name: LightGBM (default)
note: Optuna tuning brought no gain (0.953 vs 0.954 in temporal validation).

name: MLP (PyTorch)
note: Significantly below LightGBM: -0.032 [0.021; 0.047], paired bootstrap by IP.

name: Isolation Forest
note: Negative result: suspicious traffic is frequent, hence not anomalous.

name: Baseline (prior)
note: AUC-PR of a model with no information = test prevalence.
